author: Vox
description:
How do you stay employed in an industry that keeps reinventing itself? 

Hank Green is one of the most-watched and beloved science educators and creators in the world. He posted his first YouTube video in 2007, well before “YouTuber” became a job title. Since then, he’s started multiple shows, launched a conference, written two novels, and even released a stand-up comedy special. 

In this episode, Hank tells the story of how YouTube (and the internet) got so complicated — and what it looked like from the inside. Plus: why you should take the weird job, let your dreams change, and ask what your luck, and work, is doing for the world.
